title: DwarfStar 4 brings large open models to high-memory local machines
friendlyTitle: DwarfStar runs large AI models on powerful computers you control
summary: DwarfStar 4 is an MIT-licensed C inference engine for running supported DeepSeek, GLM and Qwen models on high-memory Apple Silicon, CUDA and ROCm systems. It combines asymmetric quantization, reusable disk-backed KV caches, local APIs and a native coding agent in one stack.
friendlySummary: DwarfStar is an open-source engine for running selected DeepSeek, GLM and Qwen models locally. It offers a command line, local APIs and a coding agent.
whyItMatters: Local inference can keep sensitive prompts and code under the operator’s control and reduce dependence on a hosted API. The trade-off is substantial hardware, model-format constraints and operational responsibility, so its published compatibility and benchmark tables matter more than the local-AI label alone.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Local AI can improve privacy and control. You still need enough memory, supported model files and someone to maintain the system.
